meta.title: 小说工作台
meta.description: 小说工作台把写作、资料和审阅放进同一流程。支持章节计划与作者拍板、草稿保存、章节检查和可恢复落账；导入样本可生成文风统计档案，同人候选经作者审阅并应用后才进入写作依据。

name: 小说工作台
description: A writing workbench for long-form and fan fiction: chapter plans, author decisions, chapter memory, a style profile and canon sources. Sources are assembled before a chapter, drafts are checked for forbidden phrases, address misuse and registered quotations after writing, and both manuscript and ledger changes commit in a recoverable transaction.
